assets.name: Wooden Shovel
assets.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit.
Asset type: 512x512 PNG shovel inventory / roll / collection icon for a snowy Roblox simulator.
Input image: the existing Blender render of the actual in-game shovel, authoritative geometry reference.
Primary request: redraw this exact shovel as a polished premium cartoony 3D game icon. Keep the straight shaft, blade outline, open triangular loop grip, accessory count and original identity.
Style: attractive chunky low-poly inspired silhouette, broad clean facets, subtle rounded bevels, bright controlled material highlights, soft icy rim lighting and a fine dark-blue contour for readability. Simple enough to read at 64px. Match one coherent icon family.
Composition: same diagonal full-shovel pose with blade at lower left and grip at upper right; slightly three-quarter front view. Whole object comfortably centered with at least 10% transparent margin on EVERY edge. No crop, no multiple icons.
Backdrop: genuine transparent PNG alpha. No ground plane or cast shadow, no colored tile, no backdrop, no checkerboard pixels.
Constraints: preserve the actual model's palette and silhouette. No text, labels, borders, watermark, background, extra equipment, hands or characters. No photorealism, no excessive VFX or snow hiding the shovel.
Specific model details: Warm honey-tan wooden polygon blade with exactly two dark wooden grain lines and a silver metal strip on its cutting tip; brown wood shaft and dark brown open triangular loop grip, silver collar.
